activity_probe_scope.native_focus: Three checks disable Emulation.setFocusEmulationEnabled on both real Chromium tabs, use bringToFront, and verify document.hasFocus transitions while actual Socket.IO broadcasts arrive.
activity_probe_scope.controlled_visibility: Headless Chromium reports both tabs visible. One check overrides document.visibilityState to hidden and dispatches visibilitychange, then restores the native property; it also proves hidden scroll events cannot clear counts.
activity_probe_scope.limits: No claim of real minimized-window behavior, operating-system notifications, human attention or assistive-technology verification.
